feat-dag-store.description: Single SQLite file: tasks, pre-issue dependencies (DAG), events, metrics. Recursive CTE traversal.
feat-dag-store.name: Task DAG store

feat-dispatcher.description: Event-driven loop over agent bus: consume events, promote READY tasks, checkpoint state, idempotency keys. Cron is watchdog-only.
feat-dispatcher.name: Event-driven dispatcher
feat-dispatcher.notes: DoD: crash mid-run resumes from checkpoint without double-execution.

feat-estimate.description: Time/token estimates from moving averages over run history; atlas estimate command.
feat-estimate.name: Time/token estimator
feat-estimate.notes: DoD: estimate vs actual tracked per task; drift visible.

feat-forge-min.description: Agent-native minimal forge: git hosting, issues, PRs, fast CI, main-only mirror to GitHub. Explicit non-goals documented.
feat-forge-min.name: Minimal agent forge
feat-forge-min.notes: DoD: issue->PR->fast-CI->main loop without touching GitHub UI.

feat-serve-local.description: Dev-only local server: single-file HTML dashboard (tasks, chat, history) over websocket. Never deployed to production.
feat-serve-local.name: Local dev dashboard
feat-serve-local.notes: DoD: atlas serve renders live task panel from local DB.

feat-verifier.description: Two-layer completion gate: fast rule-based checks, LLM reviewer for doubtful cases. Only the verifier promotes tasks.
feat-verifier.name: Completion verifier
feat-verifier.notes: DoD: no task reaches COMPLETED by agent declaration alone.

feat-wasm-node.description: WASM compute module (DAG traversal, estimates) + thin Node wrapper (Passenger-ready) + Node-side SQLite. One artifact runs on CPanel shared hosting and Cloudflare Workers.
feat-wasm-node.name: WASM+Node deploy unit
feat-wasm-node.notes: DoD: same .wasm computes identical traversal in Node and in Workers.

feat-xavier-adapter.description: Optional Xavier backend: CodeGraph, RAG, session history for backlog drafting. Runtime detection with explicit degraded mode.
feat-xavier-adapter.name: Xavier adapter (optional)
feat-xavier-adapter.notes: DoD: full core suite passes with adapter disabled.
